title: Privacy Policy
body_md:
## 1. Data Controller

Roland Kaubandus OÜ ("we", "us") is the controller of your personal data collected through xlmarket.ee.

## 2. Data We Collect

- Name, email, phone, delivery address (when placing an order)
- Payment data (processed by Montonio — we do not store card details)
- Browsing data (cookies, analytics)

## 3. Purpose of Processing

- Order fulfilment and delivery
- Customer support
- Fraud prevention
- Analytics and site improvement

## 4. Data Retention

Order data is retained for 7 years per Estonian accounting law. Analytics data is retained for 13 months.

## 5. Data Sharing

We share data with: Montonio (payment), delivery partners, Google Analytics. We do not sell your data.

## 6. Cookies

We use essential and analytics cookies. See our [Cookie Policy](/en/kupsised).

## 7. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, delete, or export your data. Contact info@xlmarket.ee.

## 8. Contact

Roland Kaubandus OÜ
Email: info@xlmarket.ee
